guidance.statement: We expect growth in the next couple of quarters.
guidance.quote: So we expect growth, and we will not be in a position to put any numbers now, but we expect growth in that quarter.

guidance.statement: H2 will be better than H1.
guidance.quote: We have mentioned last time that H2 will be better than H1. I think we will maintain that.

guidance.statement: Margins will go up to some extent every quarter.
guidance.quote: I can only say right now it will go up to some extent, every quarter, but, it will be early next year when we get there.

guidance.statement: We will see growth in all three segments.
guidance.quote: We'll see growth in all three segments. The architecture, feature development, integration, diagnostics and aftermarket.

guidance.statement: We will provide more detailed reporting on product revenues next year.
guidance.quote: Yes. So product revenues we will be in a position to share. And as I said, maybe next year we can come out with the more detailed reporting on that.

guidance.statement: H2 will be better than H1, and we will return to growth in Q4.
guidance.quote: H2 will be better than H1, and we will return to growth in H2 by Q4.

guidance.statement: We expect to return to normal levels of margins by Q4.
guidance.quote: We expect to go back to normal levels of margins by 4Q.

guidance.statement: We will see growth coming back to CV in Q2.
guidance.quote: You will see growth next quarter.

guidance.statement: We expect 30% year-on-year revenue growth in solutions and products.
guidance.quote: We expect 30% year-on-year revenue growth in solution and products, and we hope it will increase over the period.

guidance.statement: We expect EBITDA to be between 20.5% to 21.2%.
guidance.quote: We expect EBITDA 20.5 to 21.2 post increasing investment in AI solutions and products competency development and new markets.

guidance.statement: We will double revenue in India.
guidance.quote: India, we will be almost doubling, it's a small base, but doubling the revenue.

guidance.statement: We aim for EBITDA margins of 22% to 24%.
guidance.quote: We expect the EBITDA to be between 22% to 24% from where we are today.

guidance.statement: We will increase our investment in R&D to 5%.
guidance.quote: Continued investment in R&D, 5%, which I said, which is on top of this.

guidance.statement: We will achieve 50% revenue share from solutions and products in three years.
guidance.quote: 50% revenue share to be achieved from solutions and product.

guidance.statement: We will for sure grow next year higher than this year.
guidance.quote: We believe that we will be in a position to do it.

guidance.statement: We will improve, our growth will be higher, it will be the highest quarterly growth in FY26.
guidance.quote: I mean, anyway, we did not have much growth, but there will be higher growth in Q4.

guidance.statement: We will be in a position to have a better solutions backed with AI and have as well the other normal solutions.
guidance.quote: We do believe that we will be making significant investments.

guidance.statement: We believe that we will start reporting also from next year.
guidance.quote: We see a significant growth in the India and Southeast Asia and Middle East kind of geography.

guidance.statement: We will continue to work with them through 2030.
guidance.quote: We will continue to work with them, and there are different programs we are continuing to work with them.

verdict.headline: KPIT Technologies faces challenges with declining profits and unmet growth expectations despite revenue growth.

narrative_vs_numbers.text: Management's promises of margin recovery and significant revenue growth have not been met. The reported numbers show a decline in net profit and lower-than-expected revenue growth.

bull.text: Annual revenue grew from ₹4,872 Cr in FY24 to ₹6,455 Cr in FY26, showing a positive trend.
Free cash flow remained strong at ₹1,056 Cr in FY26, indicating good cash management.
Shareholders' equity increased to ₹3,687 Cr by Sep 2026, reflecting a stronger financial position.

bear.text: Net profit decreased from ₹840 Cr in FY25 to ₹637 Cr in FY26, indicating declining profitability.
Management's expectation of 30% year-on-year revenue growth in solutions and products was not met, with overall revenue growth at only 6.5% in Sep 2026.
Margins have not returned to expected levels, remaining at 16% in Sep 2026, contrary to management's guidance.
